assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p1.mp3.text: Leo and his little sister Elif are playing with a toy car.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p2.mp3.text: Elif took the car out of Leo's hands.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3.mp3.text: How do you think Leo feels now?

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3_happy.m.text: Take a look at Leo's face. Leo is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3_sad.mp3.text: Take a look at Leo's face. Leo is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p4.mp3.text: Leo is really angry. He has a toy in his hand.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p5_tell.mp.text: Yes, Leo goes to Mom and tells her he is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p5_throw.m.text: The toy fell on the floor. Elif is very sad.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p6.mp3.text: Leo told Mom, "I'm really angry!" They took a deep breath together.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p7.mp3.text: Elif gave the car back. They took turns playing.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/praise.mp3.text: Well done! You were a great help to Leo.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p1.mp3.text: Today Leo is going to the doctor. Mom is with him.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p2.mp3.text: They sit down in the waiting room. Leo feels a little scared.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3.mp3.text: What can Leo do when he feels scared?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3_hug.mp.text: Yes, Leo gives Mom a hug.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3_tantru.text: Leo lay on the floor and screamed. Everyone looked at him, and he felt even more scared.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p4.mp3.text: The doctor came in. She smiled and said, "Hello, Leo!"

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5.mp3.text: The doctor wants to listen to his heart. What should Leo do?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5_push.m.text: Leo pushed the doctor away. The doctor couldn't listen to his heart.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5_still..text: Yes, Leo sits still. The doctor listens to his heart.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6.mp3.text: The checkup is over! How does Leo feel now?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6_happy..text: Yes, Leo is very happy now.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6_scared.text: Look, Leo is smiling. He isn't scared anymore.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p7.mp3.text: The doctor gave Leo a star sticker. You were so brave, Leo!

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/praise.mp.text: Well done! You were a great help to Leo.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p2.mp3.text: Leo went to the bathroom and picked up his toothbrush.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p3.mp3.text: The toothpaste is on the brush. What do we do now?

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p3_bed.mp3.text: Let's brush our teeth first, then we go to bed.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p4.mp3.text: Leo brushes his teeth nice and slow. Up and down.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p5.mp3.text: All done brushing. What comes next?

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p5_rinse.m.text: Yes, we rinse our mouth with water.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p5_shoes.m.text: First, let's rinse our mouth with water.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p6.mp3.text: His teeth are sparkling clean! How does Leo feel?

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p6_sad.mp3.text: Look, Leo is smiling. Leo is very happy.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p7.mp3.text: Leo climbed into bed. Good night, Leo!

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/praise.mp3.text: Well done! You were a great help to Leo.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p1.mp3.text: Leo is at the park. He loves the slide.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p2.mp3.text: Elif is on the slide ladder. It's her turn now.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p3.mp3.text: Leo wants to slide too. What should he do?

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p3_line.mp3.text: Yes, Leo waits for his turn behind Elif.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p3_pull.mp3.text: Elif fell off the ladder. She got hurt and she is crying.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p4.mp3.text: Leo waits for his turn. One, two, three...

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p5.mp3.text: Elif went down the slide. Now it's Leo's turn!

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p6.mp3.text: Leo went down the slide! How does Leo feel?

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p6_angry.mp.text: Look, Leo is laughing. Leo is very happy.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p7.mp3.text: Taking turns is so much fun!

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/praise.mp3.text: Well done! You learned how to wait for your turn.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p1.mp3.text: Ali ile kardeşi Elif arabayla oynuyorlar.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p3_happy.m.text: Ali'nin yüzüne bir bak. Ali kızdı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p3_sad.mp3.text: Ali'nin yüzüne bir bak. Ali kızdı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p4.mp3.text: Ali çok kızdı. Elinde de bir oyuncak var.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p5_tell.mp.text: Evet, Ali annesine gidip kızdığını söylüyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p5_throw.m.text: Oyuncak yere düştü. Elif çok üzüldü.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p6.mp3.text: Ali annesine "Çok kızgınım!" dedi. Birlikte derin bir nefes aldılar.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p7.mp3.text: Elif arabayı geri verdi. Sırayla oynadılar.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/praise.mp3.text: Aferin sana! Ali'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p1.mp3.text: Bugün Ali doktora gidiyor. Annesi de yanında.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p2.mp3.text: Bekleme odasına oturdular. Ali biraz korkuyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p3_tantru.text: Ali yere yatıp bağırdı. Herkes ona baktı, Ali daha çok korktu.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5.mp3.text: Doktor kalbini dinleyecek. Ali ne yapmalı?

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5_push.m.text: Ali doktoru itti. Doktor Ali'nin kalbini dinleyemedi.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5_still..text: Evet, Ali sakince oturuyor. Doktor kalbini dinliyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p6.mp3.text: Muayene bitti! Ali şimdi nasıl hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p7.mp3.text: Doktor Ali'ye bir yıldız verdi. Çok cesurdun Ali!

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/praise.mp.text: Aferin sana! Ali'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p2.mp3.text: Ali banyoya gitti, diş fırçasını aldı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p3.mp3.text: Fırçaya macunu sürdük. Şimdi ne yapacağız?

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p4.mp3.text: Ali dişlerini yavaş yavaş fırçalıyor. Aşağı, yukarı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p6.mp3.text: Dişleri pırıl pırıl oldu! Ali nasıl hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p6_sad.mp3.text: Bak, Ali gülümsüyor. Ali çok mutlu.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p7.mp3.text: Ali yatağına girdi. İyi geceler Ali!

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/praise.mp3.text: Aferin sana! Ali'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p1.mp3.text: Ali parka geldi. Kaydırağı çok seviyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p2.mp3.text: Elif kaydırağın merdiveninde. Şimdi o kayacak.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p3.mp3.text: Ali de kaymak istiyor. Ne yapmalı?

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p3_line.mp3.text: Evet, Ali, Elif'in arkasında sırasını bekliyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p3_pull.mp3.text: Elif merdivenden düştü. Canı yandı, ağlıyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p4.mp3.text: Ali sırasını bekliyor. Bir, iki, üç...

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p6_angry.mp.text: Bak, Ali gülüyor. Ali çok mutlu.
